note: Historic roadside resort at Jelm on WY-10, about 25 mi SW of Laramie beside the Big Laramie River, near the Medicine Bow NF and the Medicine Bow Rail Trail. The RV row is on the resort's back road behind the riverside cottonwoods; most sites have a picnic table and fire ring. Also cabins, a dancehall and a bar and restaurant with seasonal hours. --Claude
summary: Operator site live (ResNexus booking; rates load from resnexus.com, not read). RV sites 30 A electric + water, separate dump, bathhouse with showers, store; booked in under/over-30-ft classes. No posted rate; Google 4.6 (312, shared with the bar/restaurant), RV Life 4.5/$$. Not waterfront stands (operator 'along the banks of Laramie River' is a lead). Phone empty -> 307-745-9638. Pin ~230 m N of the RV row.
flags: PRICE GATE (private): no nightly rate readable - the accommodations page fills prices by script from resnexus.com/RNAPI, and ResNexus refuses bots (Incapsula), so not opened; no earlier capture in audit/price_research (the 2026-10-16 WY read captured no lines). No gateway within 40 km (gateways.py: Rocky Mountain NP 91 km). Price indicator: RV Life $$ tier (stored). An ordinary resort, not long-stay in character, so 'no posted nightly rate' is not a drop.

PRESENCE: working operator site with phone 307-745-9638 and a ResNexus booking engine; Google Maps 4.6 stars from 312 reviews (the panel covers the whole resort including the historic bar/restaurant and dancehall, so not the campground's alone). Passes.
LONG-STAY: nothing marketed weekly/monthly/seasonal; RV sites sold by the night on the engine - not a long-stay park.

RIG LENGTH: sites are sold as 'RV sites under 30 feet' and 'over 30 feet' ('Please note the length restrictions prior to making a reservation') - a 23-ft rig books the under-30 class. No max_rig_ft written (the over-30 cap is not posted).
SITE COUNT: accommodations page 'ten hook-ups'; home page 'numerous (15+) RV sites'. Stored count 10 (derived) left alone; the operator's pages disagree.

WATERFRONT 'not waterfront' stands, with an operator-claim lead: 'Located in the cottonwoods along the banks of Laramie River' / 'right beside the Laramie River'. On imagery the RV row (~41.1087,-106.0123, five or six rigs parked in a line) is ~30 m from the river through a continuous cottonwood band, and the Big Laramie here is ~11-16 m wide (creek-size). No upgrade (trees between); matches the stored evidence.

PIN: stored 41.1108,-106.0122 is on the grass by the WY-10 bridge, ~230 m N of the RV row (41.1087,-106.0123); Google's pin is the lodge (41.11039,-106.01260). Under the 250 m threshold - the reviewer may move it to 41.1087,-106.0123.
